scope.execution: static source/AST and metadata only; no solver/game execution, implementation inspection, or active/new-campaign reads

scope.d: generate_empirical_tables.description_complexity: nonblank noncomment lines plus AST container members
scope.primary: both adjacent states must be historical source-hash-bound promotions
scope.extended: adds unique frozen clean post-debrief phase candidates, without claiming independent promotion authentication
scope.initial_scaffold: G1 excluded from both unconditional comparisons; scaffold assumption is separate
scope.reversals: existing _sign_reversals; flats ignored only within contiguous common known level segments; no gap bridging
scope.extrema: strict inequalities at three consecutive known levels on the common paired domain
scope.winning_source_audit: independent: retained post-debrief source is used here, never substituted by pre-debrief winning source
